info.name: Collectives Todos
info.summary: Every to-do from your Collectives, gathered on a single page
info.description:
Keep track of everything your team has to do across all pages of your Collectives — without opening a single one.
Collectives Todos automatically gathers every markdown checkbox from every page of a collective onto one central "Todos" page, and keeps it up to date as pages change.
All your to-dos in one page: every checkbox from every page, grouped under a link that takes you straight to the page it came from.
Always current: whenever a page is edited, renamed or deleted, the Todos page regenerates itself.
Two-way sync: tick a task off on the Todos page and it is checked off on its source page as well.
Yours to configure: admins can choose the Todos page name, its position in the page tree, an emoji — and switch the app on or off, globally or per collective.
Requires Nextcloud 27–35 and the Collectives app. Developed by deltadrai gmbh as open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later.
info.author: Markus Winter @ deltadrai gmbh
